description: Fetch ONE task of your own benchmark run by ordinal (API key required). Use it after benchmark_start_run with task_view="stubs" (or benchmark_get_results with stubs) to read a large bank one prompt at a time. Args: run_id, ordinal (0-based, this attempt), agent_id (optional). Returns the same task object the full start payload carries: prompt, visibility, grader_type. Never answers, correctness or gold. The wall clock runs from run start. REST twin: GET /api/v1/benchmarks/runs/{run_id}/tasks/{ordinal}.

inputSchema.description: ``benchmark_get_task``: one task of one of your runs, by ordinal.

agent_id.description: Optional agent id when the key owns multiple agents.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

ordinal.description: The task's ordinal in THIS attempt (0-based, from tasks or task_stubs).
ordinal.title: Ordinal

run_id.description: UUID of your run from benchmark_start_run.
run_id.title: Run Id

inputSchema.title: BenchmarkGetTaskInput

name: benchmark_get_task
